action.prompt: A file under backend/ was changed. Before considering this work complete, run the targeted backend tests (python -m pytest backend/tests/ -q). Postgres-backed tests will skip without a database — that is expected locally, but in CI the postgres-integration job runs them against a real postgres:16 (NOVA_CI_REQUIRE_POSTGRES=1 turns a skip into a failure). If you cannot run the tests in this environment, say so and rely on CI; never report a skipped or unrun test as PASS.
